ops.text: blob:none partial clone: a plain git fetch stages other writers' cc-notes refs into refs/cc-notes-sync/ without their ops.json blobs; sync published them into refs/cc-notes/ unchecked, and reads (go-git, GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH) never fetch, so one incomplete chain failed every answer list/search, the MCP answer_search, and the capt-hook answer capture (it runs answer list first), silently dropping owner AskUserQuestion answers. Seen 2026-10-13 in the Forge-AI/monorepo clone on refs/cc-notes/answers/207d0c2 and 25ab740. Fix: PR #62 https://github.com/yasyf/cc-notes/pull/62 (sync hydrates missing objects; reads hydrate from promisor remotes).
